title: Attributes of God
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names three attributes of God from the passages: God alone created everything (Genesis 1), God is love (1 John 4:8), God is holy (1 Samuel 2:2), and says God knows each person by name.

floor.prerequisite: Knows God made the sky, sun, moon and stars.
floor.question: Who made the sun and the moon?

representations: three cards: creator, loving Father, holy
Genesis 1:1, 1 John 4:8 and 1 Samuel 2:2 on strips
a name tag for each child
steps: Read 1 Samuel 2:2: no one is holy like the Lord.
Match each verse to its card.
contexts: a parent calling a child by name
a quiet church on a weekday

board.do: Write three headings: creator, love, holy.
Wait for the child to say perfect, set apart, without sin.

misconceptions.ask: Who made everything, according to Genesis 1?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 1:1 and count how many makers are named.

listen_for: God loves only the children who are always good
misconceptions.ask: What does 1 John 4:7-8 say about God?
misconceptions.repair: Read "God is love" and ask whether love is a reward.

misconceptions.ask: What does holy mean when we say God is holy?
misconceptions.repair: Link it to 1 Samuel 2:2: there is no one holy like the Lord.

listen_for: No, a holy God is only angry
misconceptions.ask: Can God be both holy and a loving Father?
misconceptions.repair: Put the two words side by side, holy and love, and read 1 Samuel 2:2 and 1 John 4:8. God is both at once.

checks.question: Who made everything, according to Genesis 1?
